admin.title: Certificates
admin.description: Global completion certificate template. Students earn a certificate when they finish 100% of a course that has certificates enabled.
admin.enabledHelp: Master switch. Individual courses can still disable certificates in their own settings.
admin.footerHint: Appears at the bottom of every certificate next to the verification code.
admin.signatureImageHelp: A PNG with a transparent background works best.
admin.logoHelp: Falls back to the organization logo when empty.
admin.accentColorHelp: Used on the title, border, and course name. Defaults to the primary brand color when empty.
